messages:
sara: Kicking off RC origination for v2.5.0-rc1. Need artifact pin, KV warm, and a sheriff for the 18:00 PT promo window. Please review release notes snippet before we promote.
ben: I'll handle KV warm and preflight perf checks. Plan: min-keys=128, parallel=6, regions=us-west1,us-east1.
mike: I can sheriff the window at 18:00 PT. Abort triggers: sustained p95 >350ms for 3m, any spike of 5xx >0.7% in canary, or regressions in embedding cost per 10k tokens >5%.
lina: Release notes (short): tokenizer tweak to reduce OOV on multi-language, embedding dimension normalization bugfix, minor API schema tweak (backwards compatible). Draft link: https://go/release/2026-03-21-v250-rc1. Added rollback steps and known issues section.
sara: deploy-bot please create candidate and tag artifact with rc/originate/2026-03-21 and pin to sha=beefcafe9876. Also include a note to billing team about embedding unit rounding change.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: candidate created id=rc-20260321-02, artifact_sha=beefcafe9876, pinned=true, env=canary. Promote command: `/promote rc-20260321-02 --staged 1,5,20,100 --pause 4m` Rollback: `/rollback rc-20260321-02`. Logs: https://deploys.example.com/rc-20260321-02.
ben: Starting KV warm: `./tools/kv_warm --regions us-west1,us-east1 --min-keys 128 --parallel 6`
ben: Progress: us-west1 60% -> 90% -> now 98%. us-east1 at 94%. Will wait to hit >=97% before shifting traffic.
mike: Observability: dashboards pinned and alert hooks ready. I'll monitor error budget, p50/p95/p99, DB latencies, and embedding cost telemetry. If any hard abort, I'll call it and run rollback.
sara: Canary plan: start at 1% for 10m, if stable then 5% for 10m, then 20% for 8m, then full. Manual pauses between ramps: 4m. If we hit any of the abort criteria during pause, stop and rollback.
lina: QA: quick smoke run on chat and embeddings passed. Added an eval run that compares embedding cosine drift (<0.01).
ben: KV warmed to 99% across both regions. Ready to shift 1% at 18:00.
mike: Ready. I'm on call and will press promote. Anyone oppose?
sara: No objections. Note: we'll run the billing sanity check after 5% ramp to confirm embedding rounding behavior. If billing numbers look off, abort.
deploy-bot: promote queued: `/promote rc-20260321-02 --staged 1,5,20,100 --pause 4m --notify-matrix false`
mike: Executing promote at 18:00 PT now.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary promotion to 1% started. monitor_url: https://alerts.example.com/rc-20260321-02/canary
mike: Watching metrics. So far p95 steady, no 5xx increase.
ben: 1% canary healthy at 10m. Proceeding to ramp to 5%.
deploy-bot: ramping to 5% now.
mike: Watching embedding cost telemetry now. p95 still within baseline, no error spike.
ben: 5% soak OK at 10m. Billing sanity check: embedding unit delta within expected +/-2%.
sara: Proceed to 20% when ready.
deploy-bot: ramping to 20% now.
mike: 20% soak 8m complete. Minor p99 blip at t+3m but not sustained. No abort.
ben: Rolling final ramp to 100% per staged plan.
deploy-bot: final ramp to 100% started. Draining old pods and updating routing.
mike: Monitoring post-promo metrics for 10m. All clear so far. No rollback needed.
sara: Great work team. Post-deploy tasks: update release notes with final artifact sha, notify support and billing, and schedule a short postmortem if any customer-visible issues show in next 24h. :tada:
